what_it_shows: Key figure: the known-good panel's real 1280x720 headless render with the judge's measured widget bboxes and content region, plus the pixel gate's swatch chart (measured median RGB vs the judge's ±tol mask around the analytic sRGB target) and the PASS stamp with the real determinism sha256.

Agent loop: a scripted replay of real judge verdicts in the order a fixing agent meets the failures (build error, pixel mismatch, nondeterminism, then the known-good PASS), and the self-test kill table — one row per mutant with the gate(s) the judge failed it on, kill rate from the real selftest run.

25-60 s, 1920x1080 @ 30 fps H.264 walkthrough cut from 600 real camera frames of the known-good panel (media/.frames/, recaptured each run) with hard-cut black flashes: the finished render as the hook, the spec beside the render, the judge's measured widget bboxes, the swatch close-up with its measured median vs the analytic target, the self-test terminal replay labelled with its real speed-up, the 4-gate PASS verdict and kill matrix, and a static end card with the one-command launch. Encoded with -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart from a lossless -crf 0 master (media/master/, git-ignored).
source_data: media/data/* (render.png, facts.json, grade_good.json, mutants.json, selftest.txt, timings.json) + media/.frames/ (the make_frames.py camera captures)
